proposition.claim: A literal reading applying TheoremsB/C and their tables to every tau>0 includes the round metric tau=1.
proposition.domain: Accepted analysis of M25-0233; exact scope and limits are retained in the complete report and coverage ledger.
assumptions: Each is connected, complete, embedded and proper, with dimension>=2. At tau=1 the metric is exactly round. For a point x and unit tangent v in the defining linear subspace, gamma(s)=cos(s)x+sin(s)v stays there and is an ambient geodesic; thus the submanifold is totally geodesic.
